nodes.label: Agent re-sync on SOUL.md change

nodes.label: prompts/<agent_name>/SOUL.md convention
nodes.rationale: Agents created on first startup like a migration and only updated when their soul/instruction files change.

nodes.label: Crypto Regulatory & Custody Risk Context
nodes.rationale: Crypto is volatile; Pakistan regulatory status evolving (SBP warnings, Pakistan Crypto Council, PVARA); note custody, scam and exchange risk.

nodes.label: Coverage Request Handling
nodes.rationale: Users request new symbols; analyst validates and adds to best-fitting cluster, else leaves open for admin to create a cluster.

nodes.label: Watcher Signal (buy/sell/hold/watch/alert)
nodes.rationale: Emitted only on meaningful change; confidence reflects evidence quality; signals feed savings decisions so be conservative.

nodes.label: SBP FX Rules & Currency Risk Context
nodes.norm_label: sbp fx rules & currency risk context
nodes.rationale: Residents face SBP FX rules for investing abroad (Roshan Digital Account); PKR returns include USD/PKR moves; prefer diversified ETFs.

nodes.label: Per-Tola Gold Pricing Context
nodes.rationale: Local per-tola price = spot x USD/PKR + local premium; gold hedges PKR devaluation and is Shariah-compliant when bought physically with full payment.

nodes.label: All Pakistan Sarafa Gems & Jewellers Association
nodes.norm_label: all pakistan sarafa gems & jewellers association

nodes.label: Pakistani Real Estate Drivers Context
nodes.rationale: Prices in PKR per marla/kanal/sq.ft; drivers FBR valuation tables, taxes (advance tax, CGT, filer status), society NOC legality; high fraud/file-trading risk, low liquidity.

nodes.label: PSX Market Context (KSE-100 / KMI-30)
nodes.rationale: Index KSE-100, Shariah index KMI-30; drivers SBP policy rate, CPI, IMF reviews, PKR, oil, circular debt; circuit breakers ~±7.5%/10%.

nodes.label: No Guarantees / No Leverage Rule
nodes.rationale: Probabilities not promises; no price targets without ranges; never recommend leverage or borrowing.

nodes.label: Desk Pattern: Analyst / Researcher / Watcher
nodes.rationale: Each asset-class desk has an independent researcher (sourced, dated notes), cluster watchers (signals only on meaningful change) and a lead analyst who synthesizes for users' private Investment Advisors; bots never talk to end users.

nodes.label: Credible Sourced & Dated Facts Rule
nodes.rationale: Every number needs a source and date; skip anonymous blogs/rumours; save nothing rather than guess if tools fail.

nodes.label: Signal Move Thresholds (>3% stocks/RE, >2% gold/silver, >7% crypto)
nodes.norm_label: signal move thresholds (>3% stocks/re, >2% gold/silver, >7% crypto)

nodes.label: omb service (OpenMausBot + agents gateway)
nodes.rationale: One container; OMB only listens on loopback inside it, gateway on 8790.

nodes.label: member_key (room bulletin)
nodes.rationale: Passed on every fin_user call to scope data to the person; never revealed.

nodes.label: Chat-based Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Onboarding must be chat-based, not form-based; collects banks, cards, goals, email connection and savings split.

nodes.label: Per-user Financial Advisor Teams
nodes.rationale: Study spending habits, preferred places, sadqah opt-in; savings from availed discounts go into savings.

nodes.label: Investment Advisor Teams (Gold/Silver, PSX, Foreign, Crypto, Real Estate)
nodes.norm_label: investment advisor teams (gold/silver, psx, foreign, crypto, real estate)
nodes.rationale: Each team has an independent researcher, expert analyzers and per-asset watchers generating signals; optional with disclaimer.

nodes.label: OpenMausBot (self-hosted headless)
nodes.rationale: Agents created as parts of teams; each user gets a group chat with memory only for that user.

nodes.label: Personal Financial Assistant (Agentic Savings App)
nodes.rationale: Agentic app acting as personal financial assistant/advisor to help users with their savings.

nodes.label: Deals Advisor agent
nodes.rationale: Recommends at most 3 card-matched deals; avail_deal moves saved amount to savings.

nodes.label: Deals Crawler agent
nodes.rationale: Saves deals via upsert_deal with confidence; <0.5 goes to admin review.

nodes.label: Deals Curator agent (Deals Desk lead)
nodes.rationale: Prefers marking expired/rejected over leaving doubtful deals active since users' savings depend on it.

nodes.label: Investment Advisor agent
nodes.rationale: Joins only after opt-in and disclaimer; money needed within 12 months should not be in volatile assets.

nodes.label: Savings Coach agent
nodes.rationale: Analyses spending, protects savings plan, sadqah only if opted in, never shames.

nodes.label: app_user non-superuser DB role
nodes.rationale: App connects as non-superuser created by first migration so Postgres RLS actually applies (bypassed for superusers); migrations use MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL superuser.

hyperedges.label: Deals Desk pipeline (scout -> crawl -> curate -> advise)
